bullets.text: KT Tests AI-RAN Tech - **KT** pioneers AI-driven optimization in 5G, aiming for enhanced performance and future 6G readiness.

5G Mobile Core Market Growth - The **Dell’Oro** report reveals a 31% surge in the 5G mobile core segment in Q2 2025.
T-Mobile US Launches SuperMobile - **T-Mobile US** introduces a nationwide 5G network slice tailored for enterprise customers.

IBM and AMD's Quantum Collaboration - **IBM** and **AMD** explore hybrid computing models combining quantum and classical systems.
